ValidationRule.description: Blocks manual edits to existing Membership Agreement rows for all users, including System Administrators, unless the Edit Agreement flow ticks the hidden Flow_Update__c box in the same save. Creating rows is not affected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(Flow_Update__c), OR( ISCHANGED(Number_of_Rows_Tickets__c), ISCHANGED(Plan_Type__c), ISCHANGED(Location_Seat__c), ISCHANGED(Location_Section__c), ISCHANGED(Location_Row__c), ISCHANGED(Qty_Seats__c), ISCHANGED(Price_Seats__c), ISCHANGED(Parking__c), ISCHANGED(Number_of_Rows_Parking__c), ISCHANGED(Plan_Type_Parking__c), ISCHANGED(Location_Parking__c), ISCHANGED(Qty_Parking__c), ISCHANGED(Price_Parking__c), ISCHANGED(Term_Length__c), ISCHANGED(Order_ID__c), ISCHANGED(Starting_Season__c), ISCHANGED(Seasons_Years__c), ISCHANGED(Escalator_old__c), ISCHANGED(Payment_Plan__c), ISCHANGED(Prorated_Payments__c), ISCHANGED(Paid_to_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Escalator__c), ISCHANGED(Season_Year__c), ISCHANGED(Total_Price__c), ISCHANGED(Seasons_End_Year__c), ISCHANGED(Seasons_Start_Year__c), ISCHANGED(First_year_of_auto_renewal__c), ISCHANGED(Opportunity_SL__c), ISCHANGED(Current_Season__c), ISCHANGED(Season_Start_year__c), ISCHANGED(Season_End_year__c), ISCHANGED(Payment_Type__c), ISCHANGED(Order_ID_Parking__c), ISCHANGED(Number_of_Games_Seat__c), ISCHANGED(Number_of_Games_Parking__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Membership Agreement records can't be edited manually. Please use the Edit Agreement button on the Opportunity.
